displayName: Merged Pad Annotation Table by Layer
description: Pad-level read metric for annotations across all wells in the selected fleet/pad filtered by layer.
sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH pad_wells AS (SELECT DISTINCT name FROM featurestore:merged_well_index_v1 WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(fleet_name, ''), 'Unknown') = :fleet_name AND COALESCE(NULLIF(pad_name, ''), 'Unknown') = :pad_name AND (CAST(:well_name AS TEXT) IN ('', '__ALL__') OR name = CAST(:well_name AS TEXT))), selected_stage AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_num AS TEXT), ''), '__ALL__') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) IS NULL OR CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_num AS TEXT), ''), '__ALL__') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) < 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_num AS TEXT), ''), '__ALL__') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS stage_num), selected_stage_window AS (SELECT s.well_name, CAST(s.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(s.stage_start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS stage_start_ts, CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS stage_end_ts FROM featurestore:nextier_copper_stage_index_v1 s JOIN pad_wells w ON w.name = s.well_name CROSS JOIN selected_stage ss WHERE ss.stage_num IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) = ss.stage_num), user_annotations AS (SELECT a.annotation_id, a.layer_id, a.rule_concept_id, a.name AS well_name, a.stage_num, a.substage_name, a.start_time, a.end_time, COALESCE(a.timestamp, a.start_time) AS timestamp, a.start_feature, a.end_feature, a.selected_feature, a.annotation_type, a.labeler_id, a.notes, COALESCE(a.source_type, 'user') AS source_type, a.created_by_email, a.updated_by_email, CASE WHEN a.layer_id = 'manual:shared' THEN true WHEN a.layer_id = 'manual:user:' || md5(CAST(:current_user_email AS TEXT)) THEN true WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM datastore:substage_label_layers_v3 l WHERE l.layer_id = a.layer_id AND COALESCE(l.status, 'active') = 'active' AND COALESCE(l.is_editable, true) = true AND (l.owner_email = CAST(:current_user_email AS TEXT) OR l.created_by_email = CAST(:current_user_email AS TEXT))) THEN true ELSE false END AS can_edit, COALESCE(a.status, 'active') AS status, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS approval_status, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS approved_by_email, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE) AS approved_at, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS rejected_by_email, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE) AS rejected_at, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS reviewed_by_email, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS review_message, false AS can_review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS color FROM datastore:substage_annotations_v4 a JOIN pad_wells w ON w.name = a.name WHERE COALESCE(a.status, 'active') = 'active' AND (a.layer_id = 'manual:shared' OR a.layer_id = 'manual:user:' || md5(CAST(:current_user_email AS TEXT)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM datastore:substage_label_layers_v3 l WHERE l.layer_id = a.layer_id AND COALESCE(l.status, 'active') = 'active' AND (l.owner_email = CAST(:current_user_email AS TEXT) OR l.created_by_email = CAST(:current_user_email AS TEXT)))) AND CAST(a.start_time AS timestamp) <= CAST(:end_time AS timestamp) AND CAST(a.end_time AS timestamp) >= CAST(:start_time AS timestamp) AND (CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_num AS TEXT), ''), '__ALL__') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) IS NULL OR CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_num AS TEXT), ''), '__ALL__') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) < 0 OR a.stage_num = CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_num AS TEXT), ''), '__ALL__') AS DOUBLE PRECISION))), silver_base AS (SELECT a.well_name, COALESCE(ss.stage_num, CAST(a.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS stage_num, CAST(a.record_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts, MIN(LOWER(a.substage_label)) AS substage FROM featurestore:nextier_substage_sapphire_sept3_labels_v2 a JOIN pad_wells w ON w.name = a.well_name CROSS JOIN selected_stage ss LEFT JOIN selected_stage_window sw ON sw.well_name = a.well_name AND ss.stage_num IS NOT NULL WHERE a.record_ts IS NOT NULL AND a.substage_label IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(a.substage_label) <> 'na' AND CAST(a.record_ts AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(:start_time AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST(a.record_ts AS TIMESTAMP) <= CAST(:end_time AS TIMESTAMP) AND (ss.stage_num IS NULL OR (sw.stage_num IS NOT NULL AND CAST(a.record_ts AS TIMESTAMP) >= sw.stage_start_ts AND CAST(a.record_ts AS TIMESTAMP) <= sw.stage_end_ts)) GROUP BY a.well_name, COALESCE(ss.stage_num, CAST(a.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION)), CAST(a.record_ts AS TIMESTAMP)), silver_marks AS (SELECT well_name, stage_num, ts, substage, CASE WHEN substage IS DISTINCT FROM LAG(substage) OVER (PARTITION BY well_name, stage_num ORDER BY ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group FROM silver_base), silver_groups AS (SELECT well_name, stage_num, ts, substage, SUM(new_group) OVER (PARTITION BY well_name, stage_num ORDER BY ts) AS label_group FROM silver_marks), silver_windows AS (SELECT well_name, stage_num, substage, label_group, MIN(ts) AS start_time, MAX(ts) AS end_time FROM silver_groups GROUP BY well_name, stage_num, substage, label_group), silver_annotations AS (SELECT md5('silver_substage|' || well_name || '|' || CAST(stage_num AS TEXT) || '|' || substage || '|' || CAST(start_time AS TEXT) || '|' || CAST(end_time AS TEXT)) AS annotation_id, 'system:model:silver_continuous_stage_labels' AS layer_id, 'silver_continuous_stage_labels' AS rule_concept_id, well_name, stage_num, substage AS substage_name, start_time, end_time, start_time AS timestamp, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS start_feature, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS end_feature, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS selected_feature, CASE WHEN LOWER(substage) IN ('stage_start', 'stage_end', 'open_well', 'close_well') THEN 'point' WHEN start_time = end_time THEN 'point' ELSE 'window' END AS annotation_type, :labeler_id AS labeler_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS notes, 'model' AS source_type, 'system-model' AS created_by_email, 'system-model' AS updated_by_email, false AS can_edit, 'active' AS status, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS approval_status, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS approved_by_email, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE) AS approved_at, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS rejected_by_email, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE) AS rejected_at, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS reviewed_by_email, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS review_message, false AS can_review, start_time AS created_at, end_time AS updated_at, CASE WHEN LOWER(substage) = 'open_well' THEN '#2563EB' WHEN LOWER(substage) = 'stage_start' THEN '#16A34A' WHEN LOWER(substage) = 'ttr' THEN '#9333EA' WHEN LOWER(substage) = 'pad' THEN '#F97316' WHEN LOWER(substage) = 'slurry' THEN '#DC2626' WHEN LOWER(substage) = 'flush' THEN '#0D9488' WHEN LOWER(substage) = 'stage_end' THEN '#DB2777' WHEN LOWER(substage) = 'close_well' THEN '#EAB308' ELSE '#787878' END AS color FROM silver_windows WHERE start_time < end_time OR LOWER(substage) IN ('stage_start', 'stage_end', 'open_well', 'close_well', 'ttr')), unioned AS (SELECT * FROM user_annotations UNION ALL SELECT * FROM silver_annotations) SELECT * FROM unioned WHERE layer_id = :layer_id ORDER BY well_name ASC, start_time ASC, end_time ASC, created_at ASC) q
